rows.text: returns at once when word `022CBE30` is zero; otherwise, when `ecx` is non-zero, tail-jumps (`003689E0` + 0x13) with 8 in `ecx`; when `ecx` is zero it reads byte `022CBE87` and returns without stores when that is 2 or 3, else rewrites word `022CBE8A` (to 0 when the byte is 0, to sign-extended word `022CBE8A` shifted left 3 and divided (signed `idiv`) by sign-extended word `022CBE88` when it is 1, left unchanged when it is above 3) and then stores 2 in byte `022CBE87` and 8 in word `022CBE88`
